title: Advanced Flowchart
description: A sophisticated flow-chart with custom styling, perfect for system overviews.
mermaidCode:
---
config:
  layout: dagre
  theme: neutral
  look: classic
---
flowchart TD
  A[Start] --> B{Decision}
  B -->|Yes| C[Proceed]
  B -->|No| D[Abort]

title: C4 Container
description: Container-level C4 diagram for service-oriented designs.
mermaidCode:
---
config:
  theme: neutral
---
C4Container
    title AI-Platform
    System_Boundary(platform, "AI Platform") {
      Container(api, "API Service", "Node.js")
      ContainerDb(db, "Postgres DB")
    }

title: Academic Radar
description: A radar chart visualising performance across multiple subjects.
mermaidCode:
---
config:
  theme: base
---
radar-beta
  title "Academic Performance"
  axis m["Math"], s["Science"], e["English"]
  axis h["History"], g["Geography"], a["Art"]
  curve a["Alice"]{85,90,80,70,75,90}
  curve b["Bob"]{70,75,85,80,90,85}
  max 100
  min 0
